name: DocuSign
description: Connect your own DocuSign account (JWT Grant service integration) to send, track, and manage agreements end to end: create and send envelopes from documents or templates, manage recipients/tabs/voice authentication, void/resend/correct envelopes, build and manage templates, run bulk send to many recipients at once, manage PowerForms, folders, users/groups/permission profiles, account brands, Docusign Connect webhook configurations, custom tabs, and account diagnostics -- plus bulk operations and an account health audit. Uses your own DocuSign Integration Key -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself. Note: covers the eSignature REST API v2.1 domain only; Rooms, Click, Admin (org-level), Monitor, Maestro, Navigator, Web Forms, and legacy eNotary/Workspaces are separate DocuSign products and out of scope.

tools.name: connect_docusign
tools.description: Connect your own DocuSign account via JWT Grant (service integration) by saving your Integration Key, impersonated User ID, and RSA private key, after checking they actually work end-to-end (sign a JWT, exchange for a token, and resolve your account via /oauth/userinfo). If DocuSign reports consent_required, the connection is still saved but flagged -- call get_consent_url next, open it in a browser, log in as that user, and approve once; then this connection starts working automatically on the next call.

environment.description: Which DocuSign environment to authenticate against: 'demo' (developer sandbox, account-d.docusign.com) or 'production' (account.docusign.com).
environment.title: Environment

integration_key.description: Your DocuSign Integration Key (client_id) from the app you registered at admin.docusign.com > Apps and Keys.
integration_key.title: Integration Key

user_id.description: The DocuSign User ID (GUID, found on the same user's Admin profile page) to impersonate -- the account this connector sends/manages envelopes as.
user_id.title: User Id

private_key_pem.description: The RSA private key PEM you generated for this Integration Key (Apps and Keys > your app > Generate RSA). Never displayed back after saving.
private_key_pem.title: Private Key Pem

label.description: Optional friendly name for this connection (e.g. 'Sales team' or 'HR onboarding').
label.title: Label

tools.name: disconnect_docusign
tools.description: Disconnect a DocuSign account: deletes the saved Integration Key/User ID/private key. Nothing in DocuSign itself is changed; envelopes/templates already sent are untouched.

connection_id.description: Id of the connection to disconnect (from list_connections).
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected DocuSign accounts and whether each still needs one-time admin consent.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: get_consent_url
tools.description: Build the one-time browser consent URL a DocuSign user must open and approve before JWT Grant will work for them. Needed only once per Integration Key + User ID pair, or again if consent was ever revoked.

connection_id.description: Id of a saved connection to build the one-time admin consent URL for.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_envelope
tools.description: Create and send (or save as a draft) a DocuSign envelope from a raw document: uploads the document, attaches signers/CC recipients, and sends the signing request by email.

email_subject.description: Subject line of the email DocuSign sends to recipients, e.g. 'Please sign: Q3 Services Agreement'.
email_subject.title: Email Subject

email_blurb.description: Short message body shown above the signing link in the notification email.
email_blurb.title: Email Blurb

document_name.description: File name shown to the recipient, e.g. 'Services Agreement.pdf'.
document_name.title: Document Name

document_extension.description: File extension of the document, e.g. 'pdf', 'docx'.
document_extension.title: Document Extension

cc_json.description: Optional JSON array of CC recipients (receive a copy, do not sign), e.g. [{"name":"Manager","email":"mgr@example.com","recipient_id":"2"}].
cc_json.title: Cc Json

status.description: 'sent' to send immediately, or 'created' to save as a draft envelope.
status.title: Status

tools.name: create_envelope_from_template
tools.description: Create and send (or save as a draft) a DocuSign envelope from an existing template, mapping template roles to real recipients.

template_id.description: The DocuSign template id (GUID) to send from.
template_id.title: Template Id

email_subject.description: Subject line of the email DocuSign sends to recipients.
email_subject.title: Email Subject

template_roles_json.description: JSON array mapping template roles to real people, e.g. [{"role_name":"Signer 1","name":"Jane Doe","email":"jane@example.com"}].
template_roles_json.title: Template Roles Json

status.description: 'sent' to send immediately, or 'created' to save as a draft envelope.
status.title: Status

tools.name: list_envelopes
tools.description: List envelopes in this DocuSign account, optionally filtered by status and creation date.

from_date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter items created/modified on or after this date.
from_date.title: From Date

count.description: Max number of items to return (DocuSign default page size).
count.title: Count

tools.name: get_envelope
tools.description: Get full status/details for one DocuSign envelope by id.

envelope_id.description: The DocuSign envelope id (GUID) to act on.
envelope_id.title: Envelope Id

tools.name: void_envelope
tools.description: Void a DocuSign envelope: cancels it for all recipients who have not yet completed signing, with a stated reason. Cannot be undone.

voided_reason.description: Reason shown to recipients for why this envelope was voided, e.g. 'Sent in error, please disregard.'
voided_reason.title: Voided Reason

tools.name: resend_envelope
tools.description: Resend the signing-request notification email for an envelope to any recipients who have not yet acted.

tools.name: correct_envelope
tools.description: Correct an in-progress (not yet completed) envelope's subject line and/or email message.

email_subject.description: New subject line to correct the envelope with (leave blank to keep unchanged).
email_subject.title: Email Subject

email_blurb.description: New email message to correct the envelope with (leave blank to keep unchanged).
email_blurb.title: Email Blurb

tools.name: list_envelope_documents
tools.description: List the documents attached to an envelope (id, name, type), including the Certificate of Completion.

envelope_id.description: The DocuSign envelope id (GUID) to act on.
envelope_id.title: Envelope Id

tools.name: get_envelope_document
tools.description: Download one document from a completed/in-progress envelope, base64-encoded ('combined' for the whole envelope as one PDF, or 'certificate' for the Certificate of Completion).

document_id.description: The document id to download, or 'combined' for the whole envelope as one PDF, or 'certificate' for the Certificate of Completion.
document_id.title: Document Id

tools.name: update_recipients
tools.description: Update recipient details (e.g. fix a mistyped email address) on an in-progress envelope before resending.

signers_json.description: JSON array of signer objects to update (must include recipient_id), e.g. to correct an email address before resending.
signers_json.title: Signers Json

tools.name: add_recipient_tabs
tools.description: Attach signing fields (tabs) -- sign-here, initial-here, date-signed, text, checkbox, etc -- to a recipient on an in-progress envelope.

recipient_id.description: The recipient_id (from the envelope's recipients) to attach fields to.
recipient_id.title: Recipient Id

tabs_json.description: JSON object of tab arrays keyed by type, e.g. {"signHereTabs":[{"documentId":"1","pageNumber":"1","xPosition":"100","yPosition":"100"}]}.
tabs_json.title: Tabs Json

tools.name: list_recipient_tabs
tools.description: List the signing fields (tabs) currently attached to one recipient of an envelope.

tools.name: get_envelope_audit_events
tools.description: Get the tamper-evident audit trail (who viewed/signed/declined and when) for one envelope -- proof-of-process evidence for compliance.

tools.name: get_embedded_signing_url
tools.description: Generate a one-time embedded-signing URL for a recipient created with a clientUserId, so they can sign inside your own app/site instead of via email.

recipient_id.description: The recipient_id to generate an embedded-signing URL for.
recipient_id.title: Recipient Id

return_url.description: Where DocuSign redirects the signer after they finish signing (e.g. your own thank-you page).
return_url.title: Return Url

client_user_id.description: The clientUserId this recipient was created with (required for embedded signing -- must match exactly).
client_user_id.title: Client User Id

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List templates available in this DocuSign account.

from_date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter items created/modified on or after this date.
from_date.title: From Date

count.description: Max number of items to return (DocuSign default page size).
count.title: Count

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get full details for one DocuSign template by id.

tools.name: list_template_documents
tools.description: List the documents attached to a template (id, name).

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Create a reusable DocuSign template from a document, with named signer roles you can map to real people later with create_envelope_from_template.

name.description: Name shown for this template in the DocuSign template library, e.g. 'Standard NDA'.
name.title: Name

description.description: Short description of when to use this template.
description.title: Description

document_base64.description: The base document for this template, base64-encoded (PDF/Word/etc).
document_base64.title: Document Base64

document_name.description: File name for the template document, e.g. 'NDA.pdf'.
document_name.title: Document Name

document_extension.description: File extension of the document, e.g. 'pdf', 'docx'.
document_extension.title: Document Extension

roles_json.description: JSON array of template signer roles, e.g. [{"role_name":"Signer 1","routing_order":"1"}].
roles_json.title: Roles Json

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a DocuSign template. Envelopes already sent from it are unaffected. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: create_bulk_send_list
tools.description: Create a DocuSign bulk send recipient list -- a named set of people who will each get their own copy of an envelope in one batch operation (e.g. sending the same NDA to 50 new vendors at once).

name.description: Name for this bulk recipient list, e.g. 'Q3 Vendor NDAs'.
name.title: Name

recipients_json.description: JSON array of recipient rows, e.g. [{"name":"Jane Doe","email":"jane@example.com","role_name":"Signer 1"}].
recipients_json.title: Recipients Json

tools.name: list_bulk_send_lists
tools.description: List saved bulk send recipient lists in this DocuSign account.

tools.name: send_bulk_envelope
tools.description: Send one envelope built from a template to every recipient in a bulk send list, in a single batch request.

bulk_list_id.description: The bulk recipient list id to send to (from create_bulk_send_list).
bulk_list_id.title: Bulk List Id

template_id.description: The template to use as the envelope base for every recipient in the list.
template_id.title: Template Id

email_subject.description: Subject line of the email DocuSign sends to every recipient.
email_subject.title: Email Subject

tools.name: get_bulk_send_batch_status
tools.description: Check the status of a previously started bulk send batch (how many envelopes were sent vs failed).

tools.name: create_powerform
tools.description: Create a DocuSign PowerForm from a template: a public self-service signing link you can share (embed on a website, put in a support ticket macro, etc) so recipients fill in and sign without you sending an envelope to each person individually.

name.description: Name of this self-service signing form, e.g. 'New Hire NDA (self-serve)'.
name.title: Name

template_id.description: The template this PowerForm is built from.
template_id.title: Template Id

email_subject.description: Subject line used for the confirmation email once someone signs via this form.
email_subject.title: Email Subject

tools.name: list_powerforms
tools.description: List PowerForms (self-service signing links) configured in this DocuSign account.

tools.name: delete_powerform
tools.description: Delete (deactivate) a DocuSign PowerForm so its public signing link stops accepting new signers.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List folders used to organize envelopes in this DocuSign account (e.g. 'Drafts', 'Sent', 'Completed', and any custom folders).

tools.name: list_folder_items
tools.description: List envelopes filed inside a specific DocuSign folder.

tools.name: move_envelope_to_folder
tools.description: Move an envelope into a different DocuSign folder.

folder_id.description: The destination folder id to move this envelope into.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tools.name: list_account_users
tools.description: List users in this DocuSign account (name, email, status -- active/pending/closed).

tools.name: create_account_user
tools.description: Add a new user to this DocuSign account -- DocuSign emails them an activation link.

user_name.description: Full display name for the new DocuSign account user, e.g. 'Jane Doe'.
user_name.title: User Name

email.description: Email address of the new account user -- DocuSign sends their activation email here.
email.title: Email

tools.name: delete_account_user
tools.description: Remove (close) a user's access to this DocuSign account.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List permission/routing groups configured in this DocuSign account.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a new permission/routing group in this DocuSign account.

group_name.description: Name for the new permission/routing group, e.g. 'Sales EMEA'.
group_name.title: Group Name

tools.name: add_users_to_group
tools.description: Add one or more existing account users to a permission/routing group.

user_ids_json.description: JSON array of DocuSign user ids to add to this group, e.g. ["id-1","id-2"].
user_ids_json.title: User Ids Json

tools.name: list_permission_profiles
tools.description: List permission profiles (roles) available in this DocuSign account -- what a user is allowed to do, e.g. Account Administrator, Sender, Viewer.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List visual brands (logo, colors, custom email/signing text) configured in this DocuSign account.

tools.name: apply_brand_to_envelope
tools.description: Apply a saved brand (logo, colors, custom text) to a specific envelope's emails and signing pages.

brand_id.description: The brand id to apply to this envelope's emails and signing pages.
brand_id.title: Brand Id

tools.name: create_connect_webhook
tools.description: Create a Docusign Connect webhook configuration: DocuSign will POST envelope/recipient status changes (sent, delivered, completed, declined, voided, etc) to your HTTPS endpoint in near-real-time instead of you polling for status.

name.description: Friendly name for this Connect (webhook) configuration, e.g. 'Envelope status to Imperal'.
name.title: Name

url_to_publish_to.description: HTTPS endpoint DocuSign will POST envelope/recipient events to.
url_to_publish_to.title: Url To Publish To

events_json.description: JSON array of envelope-level events to subscribe to, e.g. ["envelope-sent","envelope-completed","envelope-declined","envelope-voided"].
events_json.title: Events Json

include_documents.description: Whether DocuSign should include the signed documents themselves in each webhook payload (larger payloads).
include_documents.title: Include Documents

tools.name: list_connect_webhooks
tools.description: List Docusign Connect webhook configurations set up in this DocuSign account.

tools.name: update_connect_webhook
tools.description: Update a Docusign Connect webhook configuration's name, URL, or enabled state.

name.description: New friendly name (leave blank to keep unchanged).
name.title: Name

url_to_publish_to.description: New HTTPS endpoint (leave blank to keep unchanged).
url_to_publish_to.title: Url To Publish To

enabled.description: 'true' or 'false' to enable/disable this Connect configuration (leave blank to keep unchanged).
enabled.title: Enabled

tools.name: delete_connect_webhook
tools.description: Delete a Docusign Connect webhook configuration.

tools.name: get_connect_failures
tools.description: List Docusign Connect delivery failures (webhook deliveries that failed) for this account, so you can diagnose or retry them.

tools.name: retry_connect_failure
tools.description: Retry a single failed Docusign Connect webhook delivery.

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Get basic information about the connected DocuSign account: account id, name, plan, and whether the impersonated user is an account administrator.

tools.name: get_billing_plan
tools.description: Get this DocuSign account's billing plan and envelope usage (envelopes sent this period vs allowed).

tools.name: get_diagnostics_settings
tools.description: Get this account's API request logging (diagnostics) settings -- whether Docusign is capturing raw API request/response logs for troubleshooting, and how many are stored.

tools.name: search_recipient_names
tools.description: Search this account's known/past recipients by name or email fragment -- useful for autocompleting who to send an envelope to.

search_text.description: Name or email fragment to search for among this account's known/past recipients.
search_text.title: Search Text

tools.name: bulk_void_envelopes
tools.description: Void several DocuSign envelopes in one call, by explicit envelope ids. Continues past per-item failures and reports which succeeded/failed.

envelope_ids_json.description: JSON array of envelope ids to void in one call, e.g. ["id-1","id-2"].
envelope_ids_json.title: Envelope Ids Json

voided_reason.description: Reason shown to recipients for why these envelopes were voided.
voided_reason.title: Voided Reason

tools.name: bulk_resend_envelopes
tools.description: Resend the signing-reminder notification for several DocuSign envelopes in one call. Continues past per-item failures and reports which succeeded/failed.

envelope_ids_json.description: JSON array of envelope ids to resend reminder notifications for, e.g. ["id-1","id-2"].
envelope_ids_json.title: Envelope Ids Json

tools.name: audit_account_health
tools.description: Scan recent envelopes in this DocuSign account and produce a health report: how many are pending signature, declined, or voided, which look stuck (sent long ago, still not completed), and which have signers whose signing deadline is expiring soon.

secrets.name: docusign_connections
secrets.description: Your connected DocuSign accounts -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per account, each with its Integration Key (client_id), impersonated User ID, RSA private key PEM, environment (demo/production), and a cached access token/account_id/base_uri. Managed through connect_docusign / disconnect_docusign -- you should not need to edit this directly.
